evidence: Very low package count (2) and shallow directory structure (depth 3)
All koan modules follow a uniform pattern: import koans_plugs and define standalone test functions
No layered separation (e.g., no domain/service/presentation layers), no adapters or ports
All logic resides in flat, self-contained test files with no reuse of internal modules beyond minimal helper imports
The koans_plugs.py file is a single-file placeholder/infrastructure hook, typical of educational/exercise scaffolds
No explicit controllers, views, domain models, or ports—only procedural test definitions
All modules are at the same abstraction level with no clear architectural dependency direction
risks: Limited scalability or maintainability as the project grows
No separation of concerns makes testing infrastructure tightly coupled to test definitions
Hard to extend with non-procedural features (e.g., stateful runners, interactive feedback)
Lack of encapsulation may cause accidental coupling between koans
